facts.fact: The vendor states that CTV CPMs are often in the range of $15 to $30 USD, which is higher than other forms of digital advertising.
facts.quote: CPMs are typically higher in CTV than in other forms of digital advertising, with rates often ranging from $15 to $30 USD

facts.fact: CPM is defined on the page as the cost of delivering 1,000 ad impressions.
facts.quote: allows advertisers to calculate the cost of delivering 1,000 ad impressions on various CTV platforms

facts.fact: Cost per completed view (CPCV) is defined on the page as the amount an advertiser pays when an ad is viewed through to completion, so advertisers pay only for completed views.
facts.quote: CPCV measures the amount an advertiser pays to a CTV platform or ad inventory provider when an ad is viewed through to completion.

facts.fact: The page defines conversion rate as the number of CTV-certified conversions divided by the number of CTV-certified visits, multiplied by 100.
facts.quote: dividing the total number of CTV-certified conversions by the total number of CTV-certified visits and multiplying by 100

facts.fact: The page was published on January 22, 2025.
